intro: Bangladesh is a parliamentary republic. After the 2024 uprising an interim government took over and prepared for new elections.

chapters.title: How it works
text: The prime minister normally leads the government, chosen from the 300-seat Jatiya Sangsad (parliament). The president is head of state. For decades politics was a rivalry between the Awami League and the Bangladesh Nationalist Party.

chapters.title: After 2024
text: In August 2024 Nobel Peace Prize winner Muhammad Yunus became chief adviser of an interim government, promising reforms and new elections.

keyTerms.meaning: A temporary government that rules until an election.
